verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents itself as a drop-in replacement for Terraform that preserves existing workflows and configurations, and commits to backwards compatibility. It reads `.tf` files alongside `.tofu` files, and community users report easy real-world client migrations ("just s/terraform/opentofu/g"). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of migrating Terraform state files or a first-party migration guide (state carry-over is only implied by the drop-in claim), and no documented version-compatibility limits for the migration path.
